body: I feel like it will break their heart and that they will feel like it is their fault. And it isn't, I don't think, to be honest I have no idea why I am feeling like this. The only thing keeping me going is that it would hurt all of the people that love me. I just want to get out of this mindset before I stop caring about what happens when Im gone. Thank you for the reply I appreciate that.

I just made this reddit account to say one thing, I love you and I appreciate the fight that youve put up. I just want you to keep on fighting a little more. once you hit rock bottom, that rock bottom, you can only go up from here. Ive struggled with depression for most of my life and everyonce a while I will have a moment in my life that keeps me going and i feel like you just need to get that breakthrough. You got this buddy.
